description: This is a Java unit test class for the class ModifyAttributeLiveCommandAnswerBuilderImpl, testing various aspects of the answer building process for modify attribute commands in a live signals API. It verifies responses and error handling scenarios.

classes.name: ModifyAttributeLiveCommandAnswerBuilderImplTest
classes.description: Unit test class for testing the ModifyAttributeLiveCommandAnswerBuilderImpl class, covering various response and error scenarios.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes mocks and the object under test before each test method runs.

methods.name: tryToGetNewInstanceWithNullCommand
methods.description: Tests that passing null to the factory method throws a NullPointerException with an appropriate message.

methods.name: buildAnswerWithModifyAttributeCreatedResponseOnly
methods.description: Verifies that building a response with the 'created' factory produces an answer with no event and the correct response type.

methods.name: buildAnswerWithModifyAttributeModifiedResponseOnly
methods.description: Verifies that building a response with the 'modified' factory produces an answer with no event and the correct response type.

methods.name: buildAnswerWithAttributeNotAccessibleErrorResponseOnly
methods.description: Checks that the error response for attribute not accessible includes correct status and exception type.

methods.name: buildAnswerWithAttributeNotModifiableErrorResponseOnly
methods.description: Checks that the error response for attribute not modifiable includes correct status and exception type.

methods.name: buildAnswerWithAttributeCreatedEventOnly
methods.description: Verifies that building an event with 'created' factory produces an answer with the proper event and no response.

methods.name: buildAnswerWithAttributeModifiedEventOnly
methods.description: Verifies that building an event with 'modified' factory produces an answer with the proper event and no response.
